avis.titre: Removed skin, painful raw skin, caused scabsRemoved skin, painful raw skin, caused scabs
avis.texte: Unfortunately I would not recommend this product to anyone. This is my son's face in photos, and we were trying this product to remove blackheads to prevent my son from being tempted to pick at his skin. I didn't want him to end up with scars from picking, which he has not had the urge to thankfully. So we decided to try this product to remove blackheads on nose and chin. We did all the instructions stated, and waited for mask to dry. Once dry we removed slowly and my son squealed and I thought he was kidding around until I could see the raw spots. He rinsed with water afterwards and had burning sensation. Today we could already see scabs forming on his face. I'm praying it does not scar his face. He is only 12 with young skin and this looks like the product burned and skinned his nose. As you can see in photos it removed the skin, but still left the blackheads behind. I would not attempt any "mask" and instead save the money and have a professional facial and have extraction of blackheads without damaging skin and causing pain like this product did. ****updated from original 1 star. avis.titre: Head over Heels with this stuff!!!
avis.texte: I was hesitant to order this mask. I am 68 and have been using a mask over the years from clay to peel off and then some mostly to address very small oil and blackheads that accumulate and don't really want to go away. I have oily skin and I have never had any success with them. Well this peel off mask has made me a believer! I did several things to make sure I had the best outcome - made sure my face was well washed - I sit at my vanity and did so for application so I would not get antsy. I made sure the mask was room temp, so I did not use the first day I received it in the mail. Seeing other comments about seperating on the face, I was not sure what to expect. The silicone spatula is soft and pliable and the mask was more liquid than I thought but that was a good thing. I only put a pea size amount on the edge of the spatula at a time and I only spread it so far, which helped keep it thick but I did notice on my cheek area it started to seperate and I believe it was because my skin was warm there - so I added more. I made sure to get my entire nose especially the crease area and I also did some below my chin and jawline. So I used more than I think I would have normally used, but the price is not that bad so.... I wanted to make sure the mask completely dried and went off into my office and did some work on the computer. After a while I could feel the mask tightening on my face and I would say 45 minutes or so and it was ready to remove. I gently started pulling it back an

avis.titre: Beware if you have skin conditions
avis.texte: The SUNATORIA Blackhead Remover Mask is a game-changer for my skincare routine! From the first use, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin, it felt smoother, looked clearer, and had a healthy glow. The mask is easy to apply and dries quickly without feeling overly tight, be careful when applying, if too much is applied it will take a long time to dry and make it difficult to use for its purpose which is removing blackheads. A thin layer made the experience beyond great. Removing it was satisfying, as it pulled out blackheads and impurities I didn’t even know were there. I also love that it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, on the other hand my son has eczema and irritated his delicate skin a bit, so definitely not for him but me on the other hand am thrilled with the product. My pores look visibly smaller, and my T-zone stays oil-free longer. This is a must-have for anyone looking to deeply cleanse their skin!

I just got this and I was so excited to try it. It says to let dry for 20-25 min. It took about 40 min to dry and it wasn't 💯 dry but I had to wash it off of my face because it was burning so bad. My forehead, cheeks and nose looks like I have a rash. I have a dinner with my husband and family tomorrow and I look like I'm diseased. I have been putting a cold rag on my face and the swelling went down but the discoloration is still here! Be careful !!!

Use some ipore softener first, scrape, then use this and you will have great results. Basically waxes all the small hairs from your face/nose so it leaves your face feeling super soft. Does require a bit of extra dry time than recommended.

I bought this blackhead removal gel for my son, and he really likes it. It is easy to apply and leaves his skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed. It helps remove excess oil and makes the pores on his nose look much cleaner. We are very happy with the results!

avis.titre: Amazing Results, But Very Difficult to Remove!
avis.texte: I bought this mask after reading so many positive reviews about its benefits, and I have mixed feelings about it. The application was very easy, and I followed the instructions exactly, including leaving it on for the recommended amount of time. The problem started when it was time to remove it. It was extremely difficult to peel off completely. Some parts came off easily, but other areas were very stubborn and took a long time to remove. In the end, I was able to remove it with water and soap, but it was messy and much more time-consuming than I expected. While trying to remove the stubborn areas, my skin became irritated and red from all the rubbing. If you have sensitive skin, I would definitely recommend being extra careful. That said, I really liked the results. My skin felt incredibly soft, looked brighter, and had a healthy glow. It reminded me of the effect of a mild chemical peel because it left my skin feeling smooth and refreshed, as if the dead skin had been removed. However, it did not remove the blackheads around my nose. Overall, I’m giving it 4 out of 5 stars. The results are impressive enough that I will keep using it, but next time I’ll make sure I have more time to remove it properly, and I’ll look into the best way to avoid it sticking so much. If you have sensitive skin or any existing skin conditions, I would think twice before purchasing this product, as removing it may cause irritation.
Removes blackheads and excess oil well , especially on the nose area . Slight pulling feeling while removing. But results are good.

avis.titre: Have blackheads? This is way better than any strips
avis.texte: Don’t waste your money on those strips anymore. This is way better, lasts longer and cheaper. The biore strips are crap compared to this. You get way more for your money. Buy this if you’re concerned about blackheads or large pores. I have sensitive skin and there has never been any issues with this product. 100% would recommend
it’s really nothing special. it hurts a bit when peeling it off but it does definitely make my skin feel good and fresh

If you are worried about this product ripping your face off, don't. If you want it to be strong enough to remove blackheads and filaments, keep looking. Pros - didn't hurt. Removed very easily. Doesn't remove your hair when you accidentally get some in there. Cons - I used a hot wet towel on my face prior to open up my pores, patted my skin dry and this still didn't pull much of anything out of my face. I used a generous amount and let it dry for a good 20 plus minutes. Before yall say, wait, maybe you out too much on....well, the outer edge didn't have a lot, just a thin layer and it didn't pull anything either.

avis.titre: Great Charcoal mask for deep cleaning and overall healthier skin
avis.texte: I had read an article on charcoal peel masks and after searching and reading about different ones online and on Amazon I picked this Charcoal black mask made by Sunatoria . From the research I did I found out these masks are supposed to help remove blackheads and other impurities on the skin and basically give your skin a very deep cleaning. So I scanned the directions and put it on my face . I needed to look again at how long to leave it on , which is for 15-20 minutes and that's when I noticed it said that it may cause a slight stinging feeling as its being peeled off. So I did as suggested and I started around the edges and kinda rolled the tip of my fingers near the edge so it would start peeling a little away from my skin. As I then started slowly peeling it off it did have a slight stinging and i just went slow and stopped doing one section and switched to another so it was peeling evenly. I made sure to not put it on my eyebrows, my undereyes, and not get too close to my hairline although I did get a little on my hair near where my ears are but I was able to use a little water and it peeled off easily. I would recommend also not putting it on the underside of the tip of your nose as that area is very sensitive and it was a bearable stinging but due to the area it made my eyes tear up for a second. So I got the whole mask off and I rinsed my face with some cool water and applying some moisturizing facial oil . My skin felt so smooth and soft and it looked really great!

Satisfying to use, easy, peel lightweight but it’s not as effective as it is advertised like it doesn’t actually peel off lots of the blackhead/whiteheads. Make sure not to use it around your eyes too close because it gets really red and your mouth.

avis.titre: 2 reviews in 1 😃.  2nd time way better.  1st time removed some of my skin.
avis.texte: Read 2nd review under this. Review #1 It really had no smell to me. The product was a little runny. Not bad though. Went on easy, black as night. Kept it on 25 min. When peeling it of it took all the peach Fuze. Damn, it hurt. Bad! We will see what happens the next few days. My face is not happy. Red and ANGRY! Plus side it stayed in tact. Made removal easy. Did not see black heads on the mask removed from my face. Lots of peach Fuze. After my skin healed, I tried again. This time was better. Still hurt removing it. Stayed away from my eyebrows. If you get it on a sensitive area. Do NOT use warm water. That is what I did last time. Took off skin. Use Micellar water. Works like a charm. Will continue to use product. 2nd time, read the pics. I am happy with the product. Will use again. Second time my face was not as red due to the lack of hair from the first attempt. Still pores definitely looks better. As you see from the mask. Dead skin, black heads and yes hair came off.

I have used black masks previously. As products get popular they tend to reduce quality. I read the reviews which are mixed. I tried this because I thought there was a brush in the box. It is a silicone spatula. Putting this mask on with this tool is priceless. Wait for the product to dry in the tool and just peel it off. I love this tool. The mask was easy to pull off. It dried under 30 mins. I did fan it. I wanted the baby hair off. This worked. No itching or order. I like that the tube is sealed so the product doesn't leak. I would recommend if you want a slight exfoliation to your face. It is charcoal so it's not moisturizing. I apply cream after use.

I'll try it weekly and post if I see any results. Feels like a waist of money so far. Just the results of a typical pore strip. Update: I was really thinking it would get those hard-to-extract blackheads on my nose (and watched many reviews before buying, but it unfortunately does not). The seller contacted me and this is a top notch seller, and I have no regrets doing business with them. So good, that I've flagged them on my phone to come back to for future needs!

avis.titre: Great Deep Cleaning for Blackheads Charcoal Style!
avis.texte: I was given this product to try and I am a skeptic because I have sensitive skin where anything turns red in my face I have dealt with many products but I happen to love that this does what it says after the peeling leaving your skin deep cleansed and soft. I did notice a little redness and sting sensation when the peeling happened which I did not particularly like but overall when applied it looks like paint in your face I definitely liked the applicator brush that spread the product all around your house to make sure you experience the full effects. I would not recommend this to people with a low threshold for pain which is what I meant with the sting sensation. I would highly recommend the end result to everyone. I was proud to give it a try and would recommend washing your face always with warm water to make sure all your pores are open also for the peeling too to avoid a bit more of the sting sensation when you are peeling. I like the tightness of the product because you can feel the product doing its thing. I hope this is a helpful review and would love to know what you thought as well :)

I used the Black Mask and thought it was a pretty good mask. There is a slight smell but nothing horrible, it a little on the more sheer side than thick so you really have to layer if you like that thicker mask feel. It drys pretty fast I’d say and definitely a little tougher than other black masked I’ve used to take off. Follow the directions and make sure you hold down and peel off the same way it says on the box in a downward motion. Overall I’d say it was good I did breakout with a pimple but just means it was really bringing the impurities out, is how I feel. My little spatula tool for applying the mask came broken. Otherwise if you want an affordable black charcoal mask I’d say sure give this one a try.

avis.titre: Black Face Mask Peeling Really Works
avis.texte: First, I will state that this peeling facemask comes with an easy to spread silicone mask spatula. Once the mask is on, you don't have to worry about it dripping all over the place. The directions were easy to follow. I waited for the suggested 15 min, and my mask was completely dry. I start to peel the edge of my mask, and just a fair warning, it does hurt. I did expect a bit of tingling sensation since most charcoal peel-off mask does this. I did see results my skin pores shrunk and looks brighter. I will purchase again.

avis.titre: My first peel mask and ehhh
avis.texte: Makes your face soft at least of nothing else. I will say it does clean your pores somewhat. However it pulls every tiny hair an fuzz from your face. It also doesn’t come off in one piece. Prob half of my black heads but not all. It says 15-20 mins and mine was on for over an hour. Had to eat dinner like this. Does run a little bit as long as your in front of a mirror you can keep up with the drip.
Oh I like this right here. I wanted something to pull the blackheads out from my chin n I’m highly impressed 🩷💞

This mask was easy to apply. It isn’t as thick as some charcoal peel masks I’ve tried before. It has a application brush to apply it which made it less messy. It takes 15-20 minutes to dry. Overall was not disappointed and I got a coupon to receive another box completely free that says is given in every 50th box. This takes out dirt, dead skin, blackheads & whiteheads. It’s easy to peel and doesn’t hurt like most peel masks. I will definitely order again and can’t wait to see the difference in a month!!

avis.titre: I was scared it would hurt.
avis.texte: So I would recommend putting enough that you can grab it off your skin once it dries, but not too much because it won’t dry 🤣 It’s might take some practice. Otherwise works well enough that you’ll be grossed out. 🙂 my skin is pretty decent but my t zone gets blackheads.

While my pic makes it appear as if I’m A serial killer, I must inform you I am not. I have to tell you how amazing this product was and is. Came with applicator, easy to spread, very forgiving if you accidentally got in eyebrows (wiped off easily w damp paper towel) dried on average of 15-20 depending on the amount you applied, how thick….. most of all was super easy to peel off! Skin felt great! Cool, fresh and did exactly what is says. A must purchase again!!!

I liked how easy it was to spread and having the brush included made it mess free! The smell is alright I didn’t mind it but considering the magic this works it was amazing! The removal process was easy except for those spots that I should have made the layer a bit thicker as well as taking into account that I have a lot of peach fuzz or well hair on my face. All in all it’s a great product and I will continue to use this on my weekly routine.

New go to mask! My skin was all gunned up after two days of yard work so I tried this mask and I am thoroughly impressed. After steaming my face to re open my pores I applied per the instructions and was left with clean soft glowing skin! I was shocked at what this mask pulled out of my pores! It does sting a bit when you peel it off (like removing a bandaid) and it doesn’t smell the greatest to me, but it is well worth it for how my skin looks and feels now!

avis.titre: Great facial mask, easy on the skin!
avis.texte: This facial mask is far superior to masks that I have used in the past. For one, it doesn't have the harsh smell or smell or stinging sensation that other masks, especially a thick facial mask has. I really appreciated the high quality spreading brush that was included it is made of excellent quality. This will probably be the only facial mask I'll be using from now on. Many thanks to this great company and their product!

I was skeptical I have to be honest. However, after applying this and leaving it on for 20 minutes, i was shocked and amazed at how beautiful my skin looks!! I'm soon to be 60 and it really cleaned out my pores and shrunk them in size after one use. I will definitely keep using it!! If you are on on the fence about purchasing it, get it! You will not regret it!

Soooo....I received this in a timely manner and well packaged. Not really scented which was great for me. If thin layer applied it will have to be rinsed or rubbed off so take the time to nuture yourself enjoy the easy peel off which is refreshing.

avis.titre: It’s good if you can handle the pain
avis.texte: I like that it didn’t have much of a scent, and I was pleasantly surprised by how it actually did peel off in large pieces, however it was a bit messy and actually quite painful to peel off. Felt like I was ripping the skin off my face. I do feel like my skin was tighter and softer after so if you can endure the pain then it will give the intended result.

avis.titre: Great for the skin! Worth the money for real! And true and effective results!
avis.texte: Doesn’t really have a scent which is why I gave it 2 starts in the scent category! But overall this mask is great, it cleanses your pores and removes black heads. It’s truly worth it! You see faster results when you use it everyday like I did! My face is so clear now and moisturized as you can see in the pictures! The masked adds moisture and a little bit of oiliness to dry skin! I love it and will definitely get more!

avis.titre: I really like the smell of the mask, which is so important when applying to your face.
avis.texte: Charcoal facial masks are my favorite type of masks to use. This is my first time trying this product and was pleasantly surprised. I really like the smell of the mask, which with a charcoal mask you rarely get.

Love my Black Mask charcoal peel off mask !! It Cleanses your skin super deep ,leaving your pores nice and clean . Obsessed!!! This peel off mask does more than those nose and t zone strips have ever done for me. My skin feels So good and Definitely it has helped with the size of my pores. I like to use this mask after steaming my face so that it pulls out more. Highly recommend especially for the price !!

I’ve tried other charcoal masks in the past and they were ok. I have really oily skin and large pores and needed a mask for blackheads. This mask is amazing. I actually use it twice a week because my skin is oily and always follow up with a moisturizer. This mask has done wonders for my skin! Just watch your eyebrows cause I ripped a couple out the first time I used it 😂

I originally purchased this product because it had many good reviews. The product has a mild chemically smell at first, but the scent goes away after applying. I recommend using a generous amount of product so that you have solid coverage. Unfortunately, the applicator was broken when it arrived so I did not use it. I’ll have to find some time later to glue it back together. Overall I’d give this product a 3/5.

The product has a "clean" fragrance. After using it my face feels smooth and refreshed. I love how a facial spatula was included which made the application of the product easy. It does sting while peeling the mask off which is very unpleasant.

I took a leap of faith with this product. I needed a deep cleansing mask that won’t dry my face. I’ve tried several mask before but this is by far my favorite and it smells so good! Peels off easy and leaves my face feeling clean and radiant. I also love that it comes with a brush! Perfect for layering it on your face. My pores is thanking me after I use this. It’s my new favorite beauty ritual and pocket friendly too!

Only other time I’ve used a mask like this, it was way cheaper, everything in the package was written in Chinese, and it had a very chemically scent. BUT it did pull out the funk and was worth using. So I bought this. This mask smells great, dispenses easier because of the tube packaging, and the applicator wand is a nice touch (top piece came off right away, had to superglue) I will say that for $14, there isn’t a ton of product, it’s surprisingly small compared to other masks. The other issue I had was the consistency- it’s incredibly sticky/tacky, but it bizarrely beads and liquefies in a way I wasn’t expecting and definitely don’t like. The attached pictures kind of show how it doesn’t stay in place, and I found it dripped off the tip of my nose and chin very easily. It dries well, and doesn’t pull my face tight like others tend to, has a certain dried elasticity that’s nice. Peel off well, and takes some stuff out with it. 6.5/10

I am impressed with this little bottle! I’ve never used a peel-off face mask that has been easy to remove, but Sunatoria’s Black Mask came off in one piece. I could actually see the hairs and some sebaceous filaments caught in the mask. Be sure to use enough product when you do this, and I would recommend showering/steaming the face and/or exfoliating beforehand to open up the pores and loosen the contents. My skin is noticeably softer after using this product. Thank you Sunatoria!

Purchased this product and it came so fast and in cute packaging. I put a decent layer on my face and it smelled nice and applied very easily. When peeling off it helped to stretch the skin first and then pull gently but firmly, I washed off the places that I had applied thinner or had hair because they weren’t so easy to get a good grip on. My skin feels incredibly soft and looks glowing. Definitely recommend this product!

I love this face mask! It comes with a brush, which makes application super easy! The activated charcoal purified and balanced my skin's ph levels, my skin felt fresh & revitalized after removing the mask! It also absorbed excess oils from my skin, and helped to draw out any impurities. It gave my skin a smooth, polished look with a minimized appearance of pores. It was just what I needed - so rejuvenating! I would highly recommend trying this product!
Good product. Product came as it is pictured. So far, has used the product once and it was decent. It was easy to apply and was easy to come off.

This charcoal peel off mask works wonders! I was in the edge to post a picture of how much black heads this mask pulled out of my face but I’m embarrassed! Needless to say more, I would highly recommend it to anyone! Shipping was fast & the product was in great conditions when I got it. It’s also very affordable and perfect size to take with you anywhere you go! I’d definitely purchase again.

So this is first black mask we’ve tried and I must say didn’t know what to expect! Overall I like the product love that it comes with a stick to apply it cause it would be really messy. Overall it does what it says w has some blackheads and they came out! So I was very happy about that. Skin felt refreshed when all was said and done ✅ I recommend this product. Fast shipping btw

Its a hard no for me. Formula seperates. Takes forever to even dry. So watery it drips no matter how thin you put it on. Stretchy when you peel it off so it doesn't do much. 3 stars because I think it'd be great for more sensitive skin/not as harsh with the peeling.

avis.titre: Blackhead Removing Mask is No Joke
avis.texte: Fun to apply. Dries very quickly. So if you’re trying to even it out, it begins to wipe off and get a bit splotchy. No scent that I noticed. Felt nice on the skin. Uncomfortable to peel off, but the point if blackhead removal. So it does need to pull the blackheads out. If it hurts too much I recommend using water. Left our faces soft and clean.

I absolutely love the product, I have problems with blackheads and I love to pop them immediately. This face mask pulled them right on out. I also loved the fact that it came with a brush so that’s a plus for people who don’t like to get their hands dirty. I also didn’t feel like it was painful to take off, but my pain tolerance is super high lol.

First time using this product. Easy to apply (have to use a lot), dried in 25 minutes and holy cow did it remove the gunk! Honestly, impressed and grossed out at the same time. Will definitely order again.

I put this mask on with the applicator and it was so smooth and easy to apply. I didn’t notice any scent, left it on until peeling time. As I peeled off the mask I could see little black heads trapped on a he mask. It definitely left my skin feeling smooth afterwards and I applied my moisturizer. Left my face feeling refreshed and clean.

I have a sensitive skin and always really careful when trying new beauty products. This mask has a really nice smell, easy to apply and the skin feels so fresh and clean after using it. It was easy to apply with the application tool included with the mask. I’m very glad that decided to give it a try, it will definitely become part of my weekly beauty routine.

avis.titre: My new go to face mask!
avis.texte: This is definitely my new go to charcoal face mask! It’s not messy (thank goodness) and the smell is pleasant! I applied it to my boyfriend and I face evenly and waited about 25 minutes to peel it off. After removing our skin was glowing and felt so refreshed. Very easy to apply and remove, I definitely recommend and will be using this face mask again!

I love this mask! it's so satisfying to peel off and left my skin feeling super soft! The packaging is cute as well :) I also liked how thin it felt because I hate putting a ton of these things on my face and having it take forever to dry. You could spread this mask evenly and still have it be thin. Definitely worth the money :)

This charcoals mask has successfully cleared my pores for when I need a deep cleaning. I have large pores and oily skin and this mask is essential for my weekly routine to minimize my pores and feel clean!

Absolutely love! I’ve tried many charcoal mask brands before. This one by far is the smoothest application and peel. Face was left feel clean, refreshed and a healthy glow. I used this twice a week. I love the results and nothing better that taking pics without filters, stepping out without make up and just loving the skin you’re in!!
The product apply easily with the brush. It did hurt a bit to take it off. It works great but the brush did break as I was cleaning it

It’s okay, fun to try for a self care night. The product does come out of the tube very quickly and is very liquidity (dropped down my face a bit). The brush did okay but my hands were easier and it cleaned off well. Not very happy with the peeling process tube says to let dry for 15-20 minutes. 40 minutes later it still wasn’t dry and didn’t peel off correctly. Ended up scrubbing my face to get the rest off. I did add an extra star for the amazing company! Very polite and really appreciated of my review.

I just received this product so I haven't actually used it yet, but I'm pretty upset the brush came broken. I'm assuming with some hot glue I can fix it but thats not the point. I'm excited to see how it works when I get the brush fixed

Didn’t notice a smell as some reviews mentioned. Easy to apply with included tool & peels off easily. Didn’t see anything left behind in the peelings but skin does feel smoother where applied. Had a blackhead I’d been trying to remove for sometime & this did pull it out completely. Felt like pulling off bandaid. Will continue to use.

I loved it! There have been charcoal masks that I have tried and I haven’t been the most fond of. I have even made my own and haven’t felt like it has been like this one. It cleared out all of my pores in my trouble areas. I wish I had a larger tube. This one is really great!!!

So happy I tried this mask. I love that it came with tool for applying it, so it makes it so much easier to apply than any other mask. It dries slightly longer than it says, but I might've applied a bit thicker layer. After taking of the mask my skin was smooth and clean. Highly recommending to try it.

This face mask is GREAT! I have used it several times and each time my face feels so clean. Like most charcoal masks that we have all seen videos for, this mask is not painful to remove. There is definitely a tingling sensation but it isn't painful.

This mask is exactly what I was looking for! I love the tool it comes with. It’s super easy to spread and dries evenly. It’s easy to peel off and I could see all of the stuff it got out of my pores! My face felt smoother immediately! I will definitely purchase this product again!

Got this product as because of COVID didn't want to risk going to a beautician and overtime blackheads have been a huge problem. I tried it once and started feeling a change. My skin is much clearer and after using it for the month is did feel refreshed, clear and good as new. Highly recommended

This product is very thin and you have to layer it on thick like the package instructions say. If you do not put on a thick layer, it is extremely hard to peel off in large pieces. After using this peel, my skin felt super soft and it did seem effective in removing some blackheads.

I love how clean my skin is after I followed the directions & leave mask on for 20 minutes or more until completely dry. I peeled it off & had to wash residue off with warm water & cloth. May need to apply thicker layer.

This product worked perfectly fine with the combined skin I have. It was easy to spread using the special apply tool that was included in the box. I used it twice a week for a couple weeks and I can notice that black pores became smaller and skin looks more healthy.

This has been my favorite charcoal mask to date!! My daughter also wanted to join in on the fun. Was so easy to apply and remove. Make sure to apply thicker like instructions say. Smells amazing and your skin feels so silky smooth!! Will be a staple here for us girls

I’m a big fan of peel off masks and the fact that this one has charcoal makes it that much better. It really works well and even got some blackheads out. Definitely recommend. Bonus is that it comes with an applicator so you don’t have to get your hands all messy and sticky.
